summary: Release-sprint check of the Front of House landing page (/) and the MOD Operations Quotations workspace (/bfpo). Backend: new suite test_mod_quotes_release_iter318.py passed 11/11. Covered: /rates/current (manager 200 with rows, summary and customer_ready=false; rep 403); the synthetic workbook import-preview returns synthetic:true and its approve returns 409 SYNTHETIC; the live card is byte-identical afterwards; a rep cannot import (403); an idempotent group create gives no duplicate; the PDF is application/pdf starting %PDF and the zip starts PK; submit moves the group to pending_approval with unverified lines; approve without exceptions is refused with 422 and a readable message; a rep gets 403 on approve; the MODService portal (modsite.officer, portal=mod) does not show draft or pending quotes; withdraw works. Frontend at 1440/1920 worked: header nav scrolling, Plans going to /pulse-pricing, theme toggle, the language dropdown closing on outside click and Esc, and the sign-in dialog with its logo. At 390 there was no overflow; theme and language are hidden from the header and available in the drawer; the drawer closes via the close button, the backdrop, Esc and a nav link; body overflow is restored; the hero CTAs are full width and stacked; FR switching works. Sign-in dialog: the show/hide toggle has aria-label and aria-pressed, Tab order is email > password > toggle > submit > forgot > close, 'Signing in…' shows, a wrong password shows a readable 'Sign-in failed / Invalid credentials' banner, and a valid manager login lands on the Pulse Pro dashboard (no loop). MOD Ops: all 7 staff pills render with no console errors; ?view=quotations and &quote_group= deep links work (manager, rep and master admin); the sub-tabs update aria-selected and the description; filter chips set aria-pressed; the empty state shows for filter and search; the wizard runs all 4 steps (A/B/AB gross, review gross, sticky footer); double-clicking Generate created exactly 1 group; group detail has one primary action per state; Withdraw is a red-outline danger button; the PDF and zip downloads work through the UI; the approval panel lists 7 unverified lines with exception inputs; approve without exceptions shows an error toast. Role checks: the rep has no Schedule of Rates tab and no approve button, and mq-approve-manager-only shows. Schedule of Rates: the red mq-sor-not-approved banner shows, there are 18 'Test data' chips and no mq-sor-ready, and the history renders. No page overflow at 390/768/1440/1920 in the list, pricing, wizard or group detail. Found 2 medium and several low UI issues (below).

minor.issue: Type B-only rows (sor-1 call-out) return a.code='1B' (falls back to the B uid) and a.status='unverified' even though a.price is null. In the UI the Type A column then shows '—' plus code '1B' and a 'Not approved' chip. It should say not applicable (for example status 'n/a', code null).
The refusal (422) is correct but detail.message plus every unverified line is joined into one very long toast (7 lines at once). Suggest a short toast that points to the approval panel.

ui_bugs.issue: The header is crowded at the md breakpoint. 'WHAT YOU CAN DO' wraps to 3 lines and 'HOW IT WORKS' to 2, the logo shrinks, and 'SUPPORT' touches the theme button. The full desktop nav, theme, language and Sign In do not fit in 768px. Fix: show the desktop nav from lg (1024px) and use pulse-mobile-menu-btn below lg (or add whitespace-nowrap and tighter gaps).

The Qty column collapses to about 20px wide, so the quantity value can't be read or edited comfortably. The td has w-20 but the table has no min-width, so it shrinks. Add min-w-[72px] to the qty td/input (or a min-width on the table so it scrolls inside the card).

The global floating buttons (bottom-right) cover the wizard 'Next' button (mq-wizard-next) and partly cover 'Download all PDFs' on group detail. Clicks still work, but the buttons are visually hidden. Add bottom padding or safe space to .mq-scope on mobile, or offset the floating buttons inside /bfpo.
Item 1 Call Out (Type B only) shows a Type A cell with '—', code '1B' and a 'Not approved' chip. It should show 'Not applicable' (see the backend minor issue).

Console warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration error). The option children are mixed JSX text fragments, which get wrapped in spans. Render the option label as one template-literal string.

design_issues.screen: Group detail approval panel / extend form
issues: The exception 'valid until' and the extend date use the browser's native date picker, shown as mm/dd/yyyy (US) in a UK app. Use the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker with dd/mm/yyyy.

The Approve button stays primary and enabled while unverified lines have no exception reasons, so it always fails. Disable it with a hint until every line has a reason of at least 10 characters (or keep it but show inline validation).
The dialog runs edge to edge with no side margin and no rounded corners visible at the sides.
When the dialog opens, focus is not placed on the email input (document.activeElement has no testid). Consider autoFocus on pulse-login-email.
Switching to FR translates the copy, but <html lang> stays 'en'. Update document.documentElement.lang for accessibility and SEO.
The tabs scroll horizontally; 'Service handover' and 'Schedule of Rates' are off-screen with no scroll affordance (no fade or arrow).

action_items: Fix the PulseHeader layout at 768px: move the desktop nav to lg+ and use the mobile drawer below lg, or stop the nav labels wrapping.
Give the wizard Qty column a min-width so it is usable at 390px.
Return 'n/a' (not 'unverified' with the B code) from /rates/current for the Type A side of Type B-only items such as the call-out, and render 'Not applicable'.
Keep the floating chat/AI buttons from overlapping the wizard footer and group actions on mobile.

Optional: replace the native date inputs in the approval exceptions and extend validity with the shadcn date picker; build the SOR <option> label as one string; set <html lang> when the language changes; shorten the approval-refusal toast.
critical_code_review_comments: ModQuoteGroup: Publish, Withdraw and the Sage-ref save use window.confirm. It works, but it is inconsistent with the refreshed UI; consider an inline confirm or AlertDialog.
ModQuoteGroup approvePayload sets proposed_rate = original_rate and defaults valid_until to +30 days silently when the date is blank. Make that default visible to the manager.
A rep sees 'Edit draft' and 'Withdraw' on a pending_approval group. Confirm this is intended (the backend allows it).
The approval refusal is a 422 with detail as an object. errText handles it, but other consumers of the endpoint must handle the object form.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; 2 medium and several low layout/design issues)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST draft groups for MOD Test Site (a8fbfe01… by pytest, 58ac3856… by the UI wizard). Both were submitted and are now WITHDRAWN via the withdraw endpoint, so they still appear in the list as 'Withdrawn'. One synthetic import-preview price list was created by pytest and deleted by id (status=preview). Nothing was published, notified or approved, and the live rate card was not changed.
test_credentials: Used modsales.manager / modsales.rep / admin@pulsefitness.com / modsite.officer from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. All worked. Admin login returned a token directly (MFA enforcement is off).
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: the frontend rotates the JWT (refresh), which revokes the old jti about 60s later. Reusing one token across several browser sessions gives 401 'Session revoked', and /bfpo then redirects to the external modservice.pulsefitness.com. Mint a fresh token in every browser script (page.request.post /api/auth/login, then localStorage.token). The login endpoint is rate limited (about 2 minutes lockout after a few rapid logins). Tab visibility: the mq-tab-* tabs are only rendered in list view, not in group detail. There are no customer authorisations or handovers in the DB, so mq-auth-manager-only / mq-auth-accept and the handover cards could not be checked (only the empty states were seen). The Sage layout of the PDFs was not checked visually; only content-type and magic bytes were verified.
not_reachable: mq-auth-manager-only / manager auth actions (no authorisation records)
